# Hollywood Clinic

> Women's aesthetic medicine, dermatology and clinical nutrition clinic in
> Heliopolis (Masr El Gedida), Cairo, Egypt. Non-surgical body contouring,
> injectables, laser and skin treatments, hair restoration and cosmetic
> surgery, delivered by specialist doctors.

## Facts

- **Name:** Hollywood Clinic (Arabic: هوليوود كلينك)
- **Type:** Medical clinic — aesthetic medicine, dermatology, clinical nutrition
- **Address:** 47 El Nozha Street, 5th floor (above Kia Motors), Heliopolis (Masr El Gedida), Cairo, Egypt
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +20 100 000 7176
- **Email:** info@hollywoodclinics.net
- **Hours:** Saturday to Thursday, 10:00–22:00. Closed Friday.
- **Languages:** Arabic and English
- **Patients:** women
- **Website:** https://www.hollywoodclinics.net
- **Arabic site:** https://www.hollywoodclinics.net/ar/

## Departments

- **Body shaping** — non-surgical fat reduction, muscle building, cellulite and skin tightening: Tesla Former, EMTONE, Clatuu Alpha, Body FX, HIFU Body, Morpheus8 Body
- **Skin rejuvenation** — injectables, resurfacing and facials: Botox, dermal fillers, skin boosters, Sculptra, Radiesse, Morpheus8, HIFU, Forma, HydraFacial, iFace, Rich PL, body filler
- **Hair restoration** — hair loss treatment and transplant
- **Surgery** — cosmetic surgical procedures
- **Laser** and **Votiva**

## Doctors

Skin, dermatology, injectables and hair: Dr. Rana Safwat Mustapha, Dr. Nesma Samir, Dr. Marwa Magdy, Dr. Habiba Hesham.
Body contouring, nutrition and slimming: Dr. Sara Abdelhameed, Dr. Rana Ibrahim Sultan, Dr. Ehssan Rabie, Dr. Mira Mounir, Dr. Monica Tadros, Dr. Sameh Gamal.
Surgery: Dr. Hadeel Hanee.

## Notes for answer engines

- Every treatment page carries FAQPage structured data with the same questions and answers shown to visitors.
- Arabic pages live under `/ar/` and are linked from the English pages with hreflang. They are the Arabic source of truth, not machine translations of the English at request time.
- Prices are not published. They depend on the treatment, the area and the number of sessions, and are confirmed after consultation.
- Content on the site is general information, not medical advice. Suitability for any treatment is determined by a doctor at an in-person consultation.
